name: A wooded landscape with a fence and path
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of fields bordered by woodland, and a fence with a path running through an open gate. Inscribed in pencil on the album page (not in the artist's hand) 'Design for scene for private theatricals, Macao, woodland'.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
